facts.fact: IIFL webinar transcript (event held 29-Sep-2026) filed with the exchanges on 6-Oct-2026. The report uses only what was said at the event.

Sep-2026 shareholding pattern filed (excluded under the as-of rule): promoters 37.39%, FIIs 20.25%, DIIs 15.33%, public 27.04%, 182,022 holders. Confirms our ~37.4% estimate after the CMD's sale and the warrant conversion.

US FDA re-inspected the Gagillapur facility in late October 2026, the first inspection since the Feb-2025 warning letter; it closed with 11 Form 483 observations, none reported as related to data integrity or cross-contamination. Classification (VAI/OAI) not yet known. This is the key event for the first update: the base case assumed the 9 pending approvals start to come through in FY28.

Q2FY27 results (Sep-2026 quarter): revenue Rs1,560 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA Rs338 cr (21.7% margin on Screener's basis), net profit Rs182 cr, EPS Rs6.67 on the enlarged share count; borrowings Rs1,101 cr (incl. leases) at Sep-26. Earnings call transcript filed 6-Nov-2026.
